---
title: "How this was built"
description: "AI agents under my direction, with independent cross-review."
---

## In short

An orchestrating Claude session split the work between two Claude agents, **Opus** (serve order, serve/return
trends, height) and **Sonnet** (birth months, match length, top 10), who worked independently. Each then reviewed
the other's analysis, re-running the code and checking the headline numbers with their own code. The author fixed
or answered each point, and the reviewer verified the fixes. This review → fix → verify cycle repeated until both
agreed.

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "One analysis, from question to published page."
flowchart TD
  Q["I set the question and the standards"] --> C["Orchestrating Claude session assigns the task"]
  C --> B["Agent A builds it: code, tests, figures, write-up"]
  B --> R["Agent B reviews: re-runs the code, re-checks the numbers"]
  R --> F["Agent A fixes each point or explains why not"]
  F --> V{"Agent B verifies"}
  V -- "not yet" --> F
  V -- "agreed" --> H["I approve and publish"]
```

## Tools

Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy, statsmodels, matplotlib), pytest, Make, [Quarto](https://quarto.org) for this
site and GitHub Pages for hosting.

## Data sources

- **[TennisMyLife](https://stats.tennismylife.org)**: WTA, ATP and Challenger match files with serve statistics,
  and the ATP player database. No licence is stated on the site; the data are credited here and are not
  redistributed in the repository.
- **Grand Slam point-by-point data** by Jeff Sackmann (`tennis_slam_pointbypoint`, 2011–2024), from the fork
  [byshiny/tennis_slam_pointbypoint](https://github.com/byshiny/tennis_slam_pointbypoint), as the original repository
  was deleted.
- **[Match Charting Project](https://github.com/JeffSackmann/tennis_MatchChartingProject)**: crowd-sourced
  shot-by-shot data, by Jeff Sackmann / Tennis Abstract and its volunteer charters.
- **WTA players and matches** in the format of Jeff Sackmann's
  [tennis_wta](https://github.com/JeffSackmann/tennis_wta).

The Sackmann / Tennis Abstract data are licensed under
[CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/) (attribution, non-commercial, share-alike).
Exact versions are pinned in the
[repository README](https://github.com/danae1968/tennis_database#data-sources).

## Limitations

- **Observational data.** These analyses describe patterns and adjust for what can be measured, such as ranking.
  They cannot prove cause and effect.
- **Gaps in the data.** Point-by-point data cover only the Grand Slams, and the Australian and French Opens have
  no point timing after 2017. Heights are missing for many WTA players. The charted shot data are a self-selected
  sample of matches, not a random one.
- **A curiosity project.** This is a fan, largely AI-driven project, not a substitute for professional or peer-reviewed analysis. Take every outcome with a grain of salt.
  Corrections are welcome through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/danae1968/tennis_database/issues).
- **Snapshots.** Results reflect the data as downloaded (versions are pinned), and the 2026 season was incomplete.
